purpose: Measure guitaristic component judgments independently for each candidate before any specialist training or rubric-weight fitting.

parent_stage.finding: Five repeated pairwise A/B judgments were perfectly collinear on 20/20 tasks, so component supervision must be elicited independently per option.

batch.selection: deterministic SHA256 rank within level after exclusions, while enforcing family_cap=1; no result-driven sampling

elicitation.option_isolation: Score A alone, then score B alone; do not expose the other option during component scoring.

POSITION_COMFORT.1: very awkward or practically unusable hand position
POSITION_COMFORT.rule_tr: Perde numarasını tek başına ceza sayma. Yüksek pozisyon kendi içinde rahat ve düzenli olabilir.

STRING_DISTRIBUTION.1: very unnatural string distribution or severe crossing/skipping burden

FINGER_SPREAD.1: extreme or clearly uncomfortable spread/hand shape

OPEN_STRING_UTILITY.1: open-string use is clearly harmful/awkward for this shape
OPEN_STRING_UTILITY.3: neutral or no meaningful open-string advantage; use 3 when the option has no open strings
OPEN_STRING_UTILITY.5: clear ergonomic/resonance/economy advantage from open strings
OPEN_STRING_UTILITY.rule_tr: Açık tel otomatik olarak iyi değildir. Açık tel yoksa 3 = nötr kullan.

primary: agreement between sign of each dimension difference and overall preference
task-level tradeoff count where dimensions favor different options
higher-position option score and overall-win descriptives
open-string utility score and overall-win descriptives
secondary: descriptive comparison with historical Teacher-GOLD preference; not a reliability proof

success_signal_for_architecture_design.note: Descriptive design signal only, not a promotion gate.
success_signal_for_architecture_design.requires_component_separation: At least some tasks must show non-identical component scores/tradeoffs rather than all dimensions moving together.
success_signal_for_architecture_design.requires_interpretable_overall_relation: Dimension differences should show interpretable association with overall preference without fitting weights.

forbidden: using S0-C repeat labels as training data
changing scale anchors after seeing S0-D-B answers
